Perform job skills and functions of the Maintenance Mechanic I.

Responsible for maintaining and repairing the hospital. Performs wall patching, plastering, painting, floor repairs, drain cleaning, minor plumbing, and general building maintenance tasks. Repairs beds, furniture, doors, and other facility fixtures as needed. Replaces light bulbs and ballasts to ensure proper facility lighting. Reads and interprets blueprints. diagrams and equipment manuals.
Performs independent preventive maintenance and equipment inspections. Detects, troubleshoots and resolves mechanical and electrical issues, and pneumatic systems.

Completes work orders within assigned deadlines and ensures follow-up with stakeholders. Maintains accurate daily logs for assigned tasks, ensuring proper record-keeping. Communicates work order updates to customers to meet expectations.

Reports daily to the engineering leadership on facility conditions and progress of work. Assumes House Engineer responsibilities when assigned, ensuring smooth handovers between shifts. Ensures assigned areas remain safe and well-maintained according to regulatory standards.
Performs daily rounds, tests and spot-checks of equipment and areas of responsibility. Takes responsibility for the cleanliness and safety of assigned mechanical spaces and rooftops.
